label: uworld-api-breakthrough
context:
BREAKTHROUGH: Reverse-engineered UWorld's gateway API. Can now pull ALL question data via JSON API instead of browser scraping. This turns a 20+ hour project into minutes.

API BASE: https://gateway-api.uworld.com/api/qbank/
KEY ENDPOINTS:
- GET GetTestRecordDetails/{testRecordId} - gets test metadata + question list
- POST getTestByQuestionIndexes/ - gets full question content (text, answers, explanations, images)

REQUIRED HEADERS (all 3 mandatory):
1. Authorization: Bearer {JWT from uw_at_config cookie or sessionStorage.authInfo}
2. api-uwsub-key: {RSA-encrypted key, captured from Chrome CDP}
3. config-parameters: {"configId":7,"deviceTypeId":1,"topLevelProductId":1}
4. Content-Type: text/json
5. Accept: application/json, text/plain, */*
6. Origin: https://apps.uworld.com
7. Referer: https://apps.uworld.com/

AUTH DETAILS:
- JWT expires (exp field in token). Need to refresh via Chrome CDP if expired.
- api-uwsub-key is a long RSA-encrypted blob - captured from Chrome, not derivable from cookies alone.
- Both captured in /Users/dannygomez/Desktop/uworld_data/captured_headers.json
- Also saved in cookies.json and headers.json

CHROME SETUP:
- Chrome running with: --remote-debugging-port=9222 --remote-allow-origins=* --user-data-dir=/tmp/chrome-uworld
- Danny logged into UWorld, on Previous Tests page
